$comment: Module roles, declared once (ADR-001 amendment 12). deployOrder orders a stack deploy, bootOrder `dev up all` (absent: not booted by default), primaryService names the role's primary compose service ({slug}-<primaryService>), serviceOverride the deploy.env key that may rename it, launchCompound whether vscode-gen puts it in the compound launch. A host adds or overrides a role in its manifest (`catalogs.roles`). primaryField: the manifest field that names the role's primary module (else the first of the role).
